CourseOutcomes: CO1: control constructs and syntactic units of the programming language.
CO2: problems using sorting, searching, selection and / or arithmetic computations.
CO4: implement efficient solutions through structured programming constructs.
SyllabusText:
Familiarization with Python installation, basic syntax and running scripts in the shell,
conditional control constructs, iterative constructs. (While, do-while, for), user defined
functions and in-built function calls, Recursion, in-built data structures like List, Tuples and
Dictionaries, String processing, Files and I/O.
Implementation of Factoring methods, sorting, searching and selection as sub-routines,
simple 2D graphics.
Implementation of a capstone application to unify the concepts learnt in the course.
